title: aspidium molliculum
intro: Aspidium molliculum, commonly known as the Soft Shield Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The Soft Shield Fern has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. Its therapeutic actions include pain relief, wound healing, and antimicrobial activity, making it a valuable resource in the field of herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of the Soft Shield Fern include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
